guide.title: Nova's Overview
guide.text:
Nova is a Ranged Assassin capable
of using Stealth to confuse opponents
and surprise them with ganks. Her strongest point
is her exceptional long-ranged single-target burst damage.
As a fragile Hero with no mobility tools,
Nova needs to position safely and always have a retreat path ready.

guide.title: Nova's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Holo Decoy to counter some Abilities
Attack Range higher than most other Heroes
Stealthed when out of combat
Good at ganking or just threatening so
Weaknesses
No mobility tools
Bad siege damage
Extremely poor waveclear
Low base Health
Mana issues

guide.title: Nova's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Nova synergizes with
Nova works best with Heroes that provide one or many form of engage
or crowd control, to help her deal damage
with Snipe without the risk of missing too often.
More importantly, Nova has to be paired with Heroes that make up
for her huge lack of waveclear,
otherwise your team will struggle doing anything during the game
because of enemy Minions constantly giving vision to the enemy team
and continually damaging your Structures until they fall.
Nova is countered by
Being a Ranged Assassin with little in the way of escaping, Nova
must rely on burst damage and long range to perform well. As a consequence,
she struggles with anything that has tools for mitigating damage (for example Zarya)
and against dive Heroes who get up close and personal with her (such as Zeratul).
Nova does not like to play against global Heroes
(notably Brightwing) because they can instantly nullify
her numerical advantage when she is trying to gank someone.
Never fully commit to a gank in those cases, otherwise it may backfire.
Instead, play it safely and always be ready to retreat as someone else shows up.

guide.title: Nova's Maps
guide.text:
Nova's stronger maps
Nova's average maps
Nova's weaker maps
Nova is a good choice on 2-lane Battlegrounds as they do not require
a high amount of waveclear
and they give her many opportunities to gank
isolated enemy Heroes who tend to expose in the solo lane
(such as Hanamura Temple).
Due to her lack of waveclear, Nova is usually a bad choice
on 3-lane Battlegrounds, especially if their Objective takes too long
for her high Mana consumption to not be an issue (for example Alterac Pass)
and/or requires to kill multiple Monsters at the same time (such as Infernal Shrines).

guide.title: Nova's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
If you fire Snipe when your target is between you and another enemy, a miss will probably hit the other target and thus not reset your Precision Sniper progress.
Use Pinning Shot to make your Snipe and Precision Strike much easier to land.
Holo Decoy is useful to intercept dangerous skillshots (such as Arcane Orb by Li-Ming) or to dismount enemy Heroes.
While being easy to play around in team fights and near enemy Structures, Triple Tap is quite strong at taking down isolated enemy Heroes.
Precision Strike can be used to globally clear Minion waves when needed, especially in side lanes with Catapults.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Nova's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Nova, depending on the chosen Build, can either constantly pressure
the enemy frontline with sustain damage
or hit them with a big chunk of burst damage,
with the help of allied Heroes capable of locking them down
with crowd control effects.
She is permanently Stealthed
while out of combat, which makes tracking her position difficult
as she will not appear on the enemy Minimap in those moments.
Together with her solid damage output, this characteristic makes Nova
good at ganking.
The psychological pressure caused by a Nova pick is evident: while she is out of sight,
opposing players tend to play more defensively, opening up windows of
opportunities for your own teammates. She forces fragile Heroes to constantly
have to consider their positioning in order to avoid her damage, which reduces
their effectiveness.
Due to not having mobility tools and
being extremely weak to dive, Nova is not that popular
in the current metagame, except when picked as a counter
to peculiar Heroes who suffer the shenanigans she can perform with Holo Decoy
(from blocking Hook by Stitches
to defusing Steel Trap by Junkrat).

abilities.title: Nova's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
If you fire Snipe when your target is between you and another enemy, a miss will probably hit the other target and thus not reset your Precision Sniper progress.
Use Pinning Shot to make your Snipe and Precision Strike much easier to land.
Holo Decoy is useful to intercept dangerous skillshots (such as Arcane Orb by Li-Ming) or to dismount enemy Heroes.
While being easy to play around in team fights and near enemy Structures, Triple Tap is quite strong at taking down isolated enemy Heroes.
Precision Strike can be used to globally clear Minion waves when needed, especially in side lanes with Catapults.

abilities.title: Snipe
abilities.text:
Snipe
(Q)
Nova
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 6 seconds
Deal 230 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.
Passive: Hitting an enemy Hero with Snipe permanently increases the damage of Snipe by 6%, stacking up to 30%. Gain an additional 25% damage bonus at maximum stacks. All stacks are lost if Snipe fails to hit an enemy.
As Nova's main source of burst damage,
Snipe is an essential Ability to master.
Clever opponents will stand behind undesirable targets such as Minions,
Summons, Structures, or resilient allied Heroes in order to prevent you from
directly hitting them. They can also move in eccentric patterns or use
mobility tools in an attempt to dodge the projectile.
Crowd control effects that impair movement will help landing
Snipe, but they are not available to Nova beside through Pinning Shot.
Opponents that are distracted by certain tasks, such as killing Mercenaries or
dealing with Objectives, are also significantly easier to hit. In the end,
however, nothing makes up for being able to predict enemy movement and
behavior, for which you will unquestionably need to practice. Learning to
lead your target is a good first step to using Snipe well.

abilities.title: Pinning Shot
abilities.text:
Pinning Shot
(W)
Nova
Mana: 65
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Deal 100 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and Slow them by 40% for 2.25 seconds.
Pinning Shot's unmissable nature and Slowing effect make it
a part of a combo with Snipe and Precision Strike in order to
improve your accuracy. The Ability's damage is so unremarkable that it should almost exclusively be used when the
Slowing effect will be useful to you or a teammate, or to trigger
One in the Chamber.
Due to its long range and reliability, Pinning Shot is
typically used as an opening Ability when ganking, allowing your allies
to follow up with their own damaging
or crowd controlling Abilities.
As with most Slowing effects, it can also be used for peeling
or hindering the escape of an opponent. It should be noted that Pinning Shot
prompts Nova to automatically attempt to use a Basic Attack on the Ability's
target if she is in range, unless ordered otherwise.

abilities.title: Holo Decoy
abilities.text:
Holo Decoy
(E)
Nova
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Create a Decoy for 5 seconds with 100% of Nova's current Health that attacks enemies, dealing 10% of Nova's base damage. Whenever a Decoy takes damage, it deals that amount of damage to itself, effectively doubling the damage it takes.
Using this Ability does not break Stealth.
Holo Decoy's usage varies widely based on your opponent's team composition. In
general, placing the Decoy in a location where you could reasonably be, such as
behind your team or in a bush, will make it difficult for your opponents to
recognize which is the true Nova in order to attack you. In a best-case
scenario, Abilities may be wasted against your Decoy instead of you or
your teammates. The Decoy's attacks can also be used to force your opponents to
dismount. Holo Decoy is also useful for scouting bushes, as its death is
largely irrelevant beyond the used cooldown. Its puny damage can also be used
to finish off opponents whom are out of the range of your other Abilities.
Against Heroes with line skillshot Abilities (notably
Hook by Stitches), Holo Decoy should almost
exclusively be used to proactively prevent these Abilities from reaching you or
your teammates. With enough experience and finesse, you can use
Holo Decoy to reactively block these Abilities after you see them being cast. This
has the advantage of making it impossible for your opponents to hold onto their
Abilities for after your Decoy has vanished.

abilities.title: Triple Tap
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Triple Tap
(R)
Nova
Heroic
Mana: 100
Cooldown: 100 seconds
Locks in on the target Hero, then fires 3 shots that hit the first Hero or Structure they come in contact with for 372 (+4% per level) damage each.
Triple Tap's unmissable nature, extremely high damage, and long range make it
a threat to any fragile or low-Health Hero. The slow movement of the projectiles
fired by Triple Tap, on top of their very obvious travel pattern, means that
clever opponents will move behind undesirable targets such as Structures or
resilient allied Heroes in order to prevent you from hitting them.
Coordinated teams make using Triple Tap even harder, as the projectiles are likely to be
intercepted by the well-intentioned allies of your target. Most of these issues
can be avoided by carefully selecting isolated targets that have no Structure
or allies to use as cover. Being a stationary-channeled Ability,
Triple Tap can easily be interrupted
by various enemy crowd control effects, therefore its long range should be used to prevent this
at all cost.

abilities.title: Precision Strike
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Precision Strike
(R)
Nova
Heroic
Mana: 100
Cooldown: 50 seconds
After a 1.5 second delay, deals 435 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within an area. Unlimited range.
Precision Strike is notable for its ability to deal a high amount of damage to
any desired location of the battlefield. The 1.5-second impact delay means that
it is prone to be avoided by attentive players. As such, Precision Strike is
typically used with strong area of effect crowd control Abilities
(such as Powerslide by E.T.C.). Casting Precision Strike on the escape
path of a fleeing opponent may also force them to take the Ability's damage or
momentarily stop their withdrawal. Precision Strike's global range also makes
it useful for safely finishing off badly damaged Structures.
Once you reach Level 13, you can start using Precision Strike
for clearing distant Minion waves when needed because, thanks to scaling differences
between Heroes and non-Heroes, it will one-shot Minions. To check exactly when
that is possible, you can mouse-over Precision Strike to read
its damage at a given Team Level (your scaling parameter) and use the Target Info Panel
to see how much Health the enemy Footman Minions have at a given minute of Game Time
(their scaling parameter). If you last-hit enemy Minions with it, in addition
to helping that lane, you will get valuable Experience for your team.

abilities.title: Permanent Cloak
abilities.text:
Permanent Cloak
(D)
Nova
Cooldown: 3 seconds
Gain Stealth when out of combat for 3 seconds. Taking damage, attacking, using Abilities, or Channeling ends Stealth. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.
Passive: Gain 15% Movement Speed while Stealthed.
Permanent Cloak passively causes Nova to become Stealthed when
out of combat for 3 seconds. Being Stealthed makes Nova untargetable by
single-target Abilities and Basic Attacks, prevents Minions, Structures, and
Mercenaries from engaging her, adds a large amount of transparency to her model,
and prevents opponents from seeing her on the Minimap. Standing still for 1.5
seconds while Stealthed makes Nova completely Invisible until she moves.
Permanent Cloak also increases Nova's Movement
Speed by 15% while she is Stealthed.
Stealth is lost when any of the following conditions is met:
using a Basic Attack;
taking damage;
being hit by revealing Abilities;
casting Abilities, including Talent-based Abilities such as Rewind,
with the sole exception of Holo Decoy;
channeling Objectives;
summoning the Mount;
using the Hearthstone;
being near the opposing team's Fort, Keep, or Core.
Permanent Cloak is a fundamental element
of Nova's gameplay, allowing her to position herself to
deliver her burst damage to the intended target. It is therefore essential that
you learn the area of effect and cooldown of the Abilities that can reliably be
used to break your Stealth. Common examples include Globe of Annihilation,
Moonfire, Psionic Storm,
and Multishot.
It should be noted that the Stealthed state does not make Nova fully Invisible,
though she can not be directly targeted or clicked. She instead appears to be
transparent and heavily distorted, a visual effect often described as a shimmer.
Attentive players can spot this shimmer and thwart your surprise attack
attempts. It is generally best to assume that you are not Stealthed at all when
dealing with opponents that are not distracted by some task.
A new mechanic was recently introduced to allow you to achieve full
Invisibility by standing still for 1.5 seconds. This is particularly useful for
keeping an eye on Objectives or simply for setting up ganks.

abilities.title: Ghost Protocol
abilities.text:
Ghost Protocol
(1)
Nova
Activate to instantly grant Stealth to Nova and spawn a Holo Decoy at her location. Nova is Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds when Stealthed by Ghost Protocol.
Ghost Protocol is Nova's only reliable defensive tool. It is generally
used to escape melee Heroes who might have closed in on you, as its instant
cast time allows you to benefit from Permanent Cloak's movement
speed increase right as you need it. Furthermore, the Decoy summoned by Ghost
Protocol can also be used to intercept skillshots such as Hook
in a pinch. Under rare circumstances, Ghost Protocol can be used to get a little
bit more damage out of the Decoy it summons, though this is rarely advisable
unless necessary to secure a kill.

abilities.title: Baseline Quest
abilities.text:
Nova has a Baseline Quest which requires to hit enemy Heroes with
Snipe multiple times in a row without missing.
There is no Reward for completing this Quest but each Snipe hit against
Heroes increases the damage of subsequent Snipes. Failing to hit anything with
Snipe sets this damage bonus back to 0, making it incredibly important to
become a good sniper. Hitting non-Heroic enemies (such as Minions) does not reset
these stacks, but will not provide more damage either. For this reason, it is
always better to try and hit Heroes who are in front of other enemies
as missing will at least result in a hit.

talent_pages.text:

Longshot
(Level 1)
Nova
Increases the cast range of Pinning Shot by 30%. Pinning Shot also increases the range of Nova's next Basic Attack by 2.3.
Longshot is a good Talent which gives 2 Attack Range
to your next Basic Attack within 2 seconds after using Pinning Shot
and passively increases the range of Pinning Shot itself.
The extra range is quite useful when enemy Heroes are retreating
or playing safe. Thanks to it, sometimes you will be able to secure kills
you would have missed otherwise. You can get even more value from this Talent
by pairing it with Double Tap at Level 13.
Nova's Abilities cost a lot of Mana. To help with that, we suggest to
combine this Talent with Rapid Projection
and/or to avoid casting Holo Decoy too often.
If you still have Mana issues, then feel free to replace
this Talent with one of the alternatives in the same Tier.

Covert Ops
(Level 1)
Nova
After being Stealthed for 2 seconds, Pinning Shot's Slow is increased to 60% and costs no Mana. Bonus is lost after losing Stealth for 1 second.
Covert Ops is a good Talent that,
after being Stealthed for 2 seconds,
makes Pinning Shot refund its Mana cost
and apply a powerful Slow to its target.
You can count on this Talent for landing Precision Strike
more easily against Heroes who have access to Movement Speed buffs. For players who may
struggle with accuracy, this Talent can help land Snipe too.
✔
Advanced Cloaking
(Level 1)
Nova
After being Stealthed for 1 second, gain an additional 10% Movement Speed. While Stealthed, regenerate 6 Mana per second.
Advanced Cloaking is a strong Talent that
gives 3 Mana (not scaling) per second while Stealthed and,
after being Stealthed for 1 second, increases the Movement Speed
provided by Permanent Cloak to 25%.
The bonus Mana provided by this Talent helps you to stay on the battlefield for a bit longer,
allowing you to roam with Health as the primary limiting factor.
On most Battlegrounds you will spend around 10 seconds for going from a lane to another,
so you will end up having 30 more Mana each time you switch lane to gank.
The extra Movement Speed by this Talent can be used to move around while Stealthed
at almost the same speed as when using a Mount, allowing yourself to cast Abilities
without slowing down your movements on the battlefield. In particular,
you can use Holo Decoy to dismount enemy Heroes
without dismounting yourself in the process. You can empower this strategy
by going for Rapid Projection at Level 4.
When you do not need to cast Abilities for a while and need to travel
for a long distance, prefer using the Mount for having 5% additional Movement Speed.
If you need to cast Holo Decoy on the way,
you will stay in Stealth but your Movement Speed will drop a little.

talent_pages.title: Level 4 Talents for Nova
talent_pages.text:
✔
Rapid Projection
(Level 4)
Nova
Reduces Holo Decoy's cooldown and Mana cost by 60%.
Rapid Projection is a strong Talent that heavily
reduces the cooldown and Mana cost of Holo Decoy,
allowing you to spend less Mana when casting it occasionally
or to cast it more often for the same amount of Mana over time.
Combined with Advanced Cloaking at Level 1,
this Talent can be used to dismount enemy Heroes without slowing down yourself
while traveling from a lane to another at high Movement Speed,
although not exactly as fast as a Mount.
The cooldown reduction can be used to trigger
One in the Chamber at level 7 more often.
That said, you should usually hold Holo Decoy
for blocking skillshot-based Abilities
or use it for scouting dangerous areas before walking nearby.
?
Holo Stability
(Level 4)
Nova
Increase the cast range of Holo Decoy by 100% and its duration by 120%.
Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Ghost Protocol by 15 seconds.
Holo Stability is a good Talent that
reduces the cooldown of Ghost Protocol to 45 seconds
and increases the duration and range of Holo Decoy,
allowing you to poke and dismount from a higher distance.
The doubled duration has synergy with Lethal Decoy at Level 16
and Rewind at Level 20, effectively doubling
Holo Decoy's damage output
against isolated enemies.
The cooldown reduction can be useful when you desperately need the on-demand
Stealth provided by Ghost Protocol
as a counter for powerful enemy Abilities which require the target to be visible.
?
Covert Mission
(Level 4)
Nova
Cooldown: 0.25 seconds
Enemy Minions killed near Nova grant a stack of Bribe. Hero Takedowns grant 10 stacks of Bribe. Use 25 stacks to bribe a Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum of 100 stacks. If a camp is defeated entirely with Bribe, the camp respawns 50% faster.
Covert Mission is a good Talent which gives Nova the ability to instantly kill
a non-Elite Mercenary with each Charge accumulated
by killing Minions and Heroes during the game. Mercenary Camps entirely captured
this way will respawn in half the time.
Keep in mind that you cannot use Bribe effects on Elite Mercenaries
(the Sentinel from the Sentinel Camp on Hanamura Temple
and the Support Camp on Volskaya Foundry, and all Bosses
from any Boss Camp on Battlegrounds featuring them).
Being able to capture Mercenary Camps helps to compensate for Nova's lack
of macro. The faster respawn allows your team
to use a given Mercenary Camp more often, something that is especially useful
for the non-Elite ones dropping Items (the Fortification Camps
on Volskaya Foundry and Hanamura Temple).

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Nova
talent_pages.text:
?
Perfect Shot
(Level 7)
Nova
Hitting an enemy with Snipe reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds and refunds half its Mana cost, doubled against enemy Heroes.
Perfect Shot is a good Talent that
reduces cooldown and mana cost of Snipe
by 2 seconds and 25 Mana when used on non-Heroes
or by 4 seconds and 50 Mana when used on Heroes.
The cooldown reduction against Heroes included in this Talent,
together with the bonus damage coming from 5 stacks of Precision Sniper,
makes it the best sustain damage
option in this Tier when fighting against enemy Heroes,
but only if you are facing easy-to-hit opponents.
The cooldown reduction against non-Heroes helps when capturing Mercenaries,
defending Mercenaries, taking down Monsters, or damaging enemy Structures.
In addition to that, if you miss a Hero and happen to hit a non-Hero behind them,
you will not lose Precision Sniper stacks and you will get some cooldown reduction
as well as some Mana back.
Since missing enemies with Snipe will result
in losing all stacks of Precision Sniper,
we recommend picking this Talent in combination with
Psionic Efficiency at Level 13,
to get them back faster.
?
One in the Chamber
(Level 7)
Nova
After using an Ability, Nova's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals 65% additional damage.
One in the Chamber is a good Talent that empowers
the next Basic Attack you execute after casting any Ability,
resulting in a higher damage output if you make sure to Basic Attack
after casting each Ability.
Double Tap at Level 13
and Rewind at Level 20 have great synergy
with this Talent as they allow you to cast your Abilities more often.
Similarly, Rapid Projection at Level 4
has moderate synergy for the same reason.
While you do not want to spend a long utility
cooldown just to deal a bit more damage, it is good to know that activating
Ghost Protocol will trigger this Talent too.
✔
Anti-Armor Shells
(Level 7)
Nova
Nova's Basic Attacks deal 250% damage and decrease the Physical Armor of Heroic targets by 15 for 4 seconds, but her Attack Speed is proportionally slower.
Although Anti-Armor Shells is a strong Talent that increases your
Attack Damage (from 105 to 262.5) but proportionally decreases your Attack Speed (from 1 to 0.4).
In addition to that, right before dealing damage, your Basic Attacks reduce
the Physical Armor of enemy Heroes hit,
resulting in 15% more damage per second from your Basic Attacks.
The primary advantage coming from this Talent is the ability to constantly
deal more damage without having to spend Mana, something that indirectly increases
your Map uptime as you will have to Hearthstone less often.
Coming in big chunks, the damage from this Talent is quite useful
to deal as much damage as possible to high-mobility Heroes
(Zeratul comes to mind) before they quickly move out of Attack Range
or to deal constantly deal damage without exposing too much as you will have
2.5 seconds to move between Basic Attacks.
The extremely slow Attack Speed and drastically different gameplay may be confusing at first,
so we do not recommend this Talent if you are new to the Hero. Instead,
start with One in the Chamber that is easier to use.
You can combine this Talent with Lethal Decoy at Level 16
to make your Clones deal even more damage when they attack the same target as Nova because
their Basic Attacks benefit from Physical Armor reduction effects.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Nova
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
?
Triple Tap
(Level 10)
Nova
Mana: 100
Cooldown: 100 seconds
Locks in on the target Hero, then fires 3 shots that hit the first Hero or Structure they come in contact with for 372 (+4% per level) damage each.
Triple Tap is a good Heroic Ability that
can be used to deal an extremely high amount of damage to a single enemy Hero,
sometimes even from high distance, granted there are no other Heroes
or enemy Structures the way. Just be careful when using it, though,
as you will be locked in place for 2.3 seconds.
✔
Precision Strike
(Level 10)
Nova
Mana: 100
Cooldown: 50 seconds
After a 1.5 second delay, deals 435 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within an area. Unlimited range.
Precision Strike is a strong Heroic Ability
that deals a significant amount of damage in a large area
from global range.
You can use this Heroic Ability as a follow-up
to help your teammates when they are trying to kill an enemy Hero anywhere on the battlefield.
When alone, use Pinning Shot as a setup instead.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Nova
talent_pages.text:
?
Psionic Efficiency
(Level 13)
Nova
Snipe's range is increased by 15% and hitting a Hero grants an additional stack of Precision Sniper.
Psionic Efficiency is a good Talent that helps you
stack Precision Sniper, Nova's Baseline Quest,
and slightly increases the range of Snipe.
Getting twice the default amount of Precision Sniper stack
makes your damage ramp up quicker, especially when playing Perfect Shot at Level 7,
and helps you build it up again when you happen to miss enemies with Snipe.
The range increase is not surprising, however, it may occasionally turn a miss into a hit
or at least a Hero miss into a non-Hero hit, thus saving Precision Sniper stacks.
When possible, try to position yourself and aim Snipe in a way
that takes advantage of this: with the target between you and another enemy.
?
Double Tap
(Level 13)
Nova
Pinning Shot now has 2 charges, but its cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.
Double Tap is a good Talent that
gives you access to a second charge of Pinning Shot
at the cost of having a slightly longer cooldown for each of them.
After casting one of them, you will have to wait 1 second before being able to cast the other.
After casting both of them, you will have to wait twice the cooldown to be able to repeat so.
The additional charge provided has synergy with Longshot at Level 1
and Crippling Shot at Level 16 because you will be able to use them
more often during short team fights and can be used to get an additional trigger from
One in the Chamber at Level 7.
When your team is not providing crowd control,
Pinning Shot is usually being used as a setup
for Snipe and Precision Strike, however,
that is not always possible due to their cooldowns not aligning well. The second
charge of Pinning Shot will help with that.
✔
Ionic Force Field
(Level 13)
Nova
Gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds after losing Stealth.
Ionic Force Field is a strong Talent that increases
your survivability by giving you a fair amount of Armor right after Stealth ends.
Clones will benefit from this Talent as well, so they will be harder to take down for 3 seconds
and the enemy team will not be able to easily spot the real Nova because of it.
In case you are going to take damage while in Stealth and you want to mitigate it
(for example Consume Souls by Mephisto),
you can manually break Stealth by briefly channeling your Hearthstone
or your Mount and then immediately stop channeling to keep moving in the direction you intend to go.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Nova
talent_pages.text:
?
Explosive Round
(Level 16)
Nova
Snipe also deals 90% damage to enemies near the impact.
Explosive Round is a good Talent that, thanks to the 3.5 explosion radius,
allows otherwise impossible Snipe casts to deal damage.
Even if your intended target is hiding behind another enemy,
you will still be able to hit them for only 10% less damage.
Against team compositions featuring many low-range or melee Heroes,
this Talent can deal a huge amount of damage,
especially if you have Perfect Shot at Level 7
to be able to use Snipe more often.
?
Crippling Shot
(Level 16)
Nova
Pinning Shot lowers a Hero's Armor by 20 for the duration of the Slow, causing them to take 20% increased damage.
Crippling Shot is a strong Talent which makes
every Pinning Shot reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit
for 2.25 seconds, regardless of the Slow being removed or not.
As always, Armor reduction effects
provide a significant damage increase for yourself and your entire team,
making it a great tool for burst compositions.
To get the most value out of this Talent, focus the same Heroes
that are being targeted by your teammates.
You can and should combine this Talent with Double Tap at Level 13
because it helps you get the Armor reduction effect going
when you want to cast Snipe a second time
or when you want to use another Precision Strike,
if you have Precision Barrage at Level 20.
✔
Lethal Decoy
(Level 16)
Nova
Increases the damage Holo Decoy deals to 30% of Nova's damage.
Lethal Decoy is a strong Talent that turns Holo Decoy
from defensive and utility Ability to offensive Ability. Thanks to this Talent,
Clones will deal 30% damage compared to Nova, rather than 10% baseline damage.
The only drawback is that Clones will not necessarily target who you would like to.
You can use Holo Decoy, Ghost Protocol,
and Rewind at Level 20 to reset their cooldowns
and spawn multiple Clones at the same time. The resulting damage output
against isolated enemy Heroes should not be underestimated, especially
with Anti-Armor Shells to reduce your target's
Physical Armor.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Nova
talent_pages.text:
✘
Fast Reload
(Level 20)
Nova
Triple Tap's cooldown is reset if it kills an enemy Hero.
Fast Reload is a weak Talent
which relies on the unlikely event that a Hero dies within 0.625 seconds
of being hit by Triple Tap.
Due to its win-more nature, we do not recommend to choose this Talent.
If you want to deal more damage, Rewind is powerful and reliable.
?
Precision Barrage
(Level 20)
Nova
Precision Strike gains a 2nd charge and its cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.
Precision Barrage is a strong Talent that unlocks
a second charge of Precision Strike,
usable only after a short delay of 3 seconds from the first one being used,
and reduces its cooldown from 50 to 25 seconds.
After casting one of them, you will have to wait 3 second before being able to cast the other.
After casting both of them, you will have to wait twice the cooldown to be able to repeat so.
You may need this Talent not only to take down enemy Heroes
but also to clear enemy Minions from global range
as a way to lessen the macro pressure on your team
or to increase the macro pressure on the enemy team.
This trick is particularly useful in side lanes with Catapults.
?
Apollo Suit
(Level 20)
Nova
Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 2 seconds.
Apollo Suit is a good Talent that
makes you become Stealthed after
not being in combat for just 1 second, rather than 3 seconds
from baseline Permanent Cloak.
As a consequence, when trying to chase or flee,
you will get additional Movement Speed almost immediately.
While this Talent is not great on its own,
it can be combined with Advanced Cloaking at Level 1
and Ionic Force Field at Level 13
to increase your survivability. If you are good with mind games,
you can use this Talent to confuse enemy Heroes who are trying
to find the real Nova surrounded by various Clones.
✔
Rewind
(Level 20)
Nova
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.
Rewind is a strong Talent that
can be activated to reset the cooldown of all your Basic Abilities,
including Ghost Protocol.
Cast them twice in a row to deal high burst damage.
The extra Clones can be used to further confuse enemy Heroes.
You can use this Talent in combination with One in the Chamber at Level 7
to deal even more damage, if you alternate Abilities and Basic Attacks.
On the other hand, you should avoid picking it when you already have
Perfect Shot at Level 7 because,
due to Snipe having way lower cooldown when used
against enemy Heroes, you will get less value from the cooldown reset.
